body:
A software developer with 10 years at top tech companies feels stuck. 
AI is automating more of his code, and moving into product or business means proving new skills. 

The fix: learn how a business runs, make real revenue from scratch, meet people in leadership roles and learn to build products, not just code. 

Ascend, Mesa's Hybrid PGP in Business, AI & Entrepreneurship, covers all four in 12 months of weekends. 

For professionals with 5+ years of experience. Apply now.
headline: Developer? Learn the business side
